description: Reviewed 50-90% win-rate band for the level-10 Goblin Warrior, Shortsword, Heavy Breastplate, Amulet and Goblin second-slot build in each fixed Crystal Creek pairing. Duration has no acceptance target. The other fourteen preparation/return cells remain declared diagnostics.

goals.rationale: Each fixed Crystal Creek pairing must have its pointwise 95% Wilson interval wholly inside the inclusive 50-90% band; overlap remains Inconclusive. At least 100 valid trials are required. These conditional fixed-reward encounters are not an area-wide spawn estimate. Duration, optional Fury and alternative preparations do not gate this policy. Completed reference/confirmation runs are evaluated separately without adding samples or changing fixtures.
goals.reviewReason: On 8 September 2026 the user explicitly requested the 50-90% win band for this level-10 Amulet/Goblin checkpoint and said duration does not matter. This approves this scoped policy, not a balance change, passing baseline, duration gate or hosted gameplay gate.
